environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 API deployed on Azure App Service. SQL Server database connection uses a service account 'vault_app_svc' with db_owner role. The application handles encryption/decryption of secrets stored in the database. The same hardcoded key is used for both AES-256-CBC encryption and HMAC-SHA256 signing, enabling an attacker who compromises the key to forge valid HMACs for arbitrary ciphertexts and inject malicious encrypted records via the POST/PUT endpoints.

config.auth: JWT bearer with RS256, admin role claims self-asserted via token
